summary: Russian forces liberated Novosoloshino village in Zaporizhzhia region while launching massive UAV waves across Ukraine including Kyiv, Sumy, Dnipro, and Odesa regions. Ukraine's Patriot air defense systems are nearly out of interceptor missiles with one launcher unfired for six weeks. Russia has built at least 10 new UAV launch bases along Ukrainian and Belarusian borders with 59 identified launch rails.
key_points: Russian MoD announced liberation of Novosoloshino village north of Orekhovo in Zaporizhzhia region with MoD releasing battle footage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32519)

Russian air defenses intercepting nearly all Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missiles with only 1-2 of 11 FP-5 missiles reaching targets recently due to A-50U early-warning aircraft deployment since July. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32529)
CNN reports Ukraine almost exhausted Patriot interceptor missiles; one launcher unfired for ~6 weeks rendering system useless against ballistic missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32531)
Russian overnight UAV attack on Sumy private sector killed 75-year-old man and 72-year-old woman, injured one woman, destroyed two houses, damaged 42 estates. (Source: @UkraineNow/83478)
Russian UAV attack damaged civilian vessel under Togo flag in Odesa port infrastructure; four injured, three hospitalized, one in serious condition. (Source: @UkraineNow/83478)
Russia built at least 10 military bases along Ukraine/Belarus borders for mass jet UAV launches with 59 new launch rails identified per The Telegraph. (Source: @UkraineNow/83477)
Ukrainian MoD codified "Dovbush" UAV with 2,000+ km range, 24+ hour endurance capable of striking Urals and Siberia targets. (Source: @UkraineNow/83492)
Moscow air defenses destroyed 63 UAVs on approach since start of day per Sobyanin; separate reports cite 10 and 6 UAVs destroyed in earlier waves. (Source: @tass_agency/390750)

points: Ukraine has almost exhausted its stock of interceptor missiles for American Patriot systems and in some cases can no longer use them against ballistic missiles; one launcher has not fired for about six weeks rendering the system useless without interceptors per CNN. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32531)
CNN footage shows abandoned Ukrainian Patriot missile systems in a cornfield near Kiev with last firing approximately ten weeks ago. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32535)

Ukrainian MoD codified "Dovbush" UAV with flight range over 2,000 km and endurance over 24 hours, capable of reconnaissance, fire correction, strikes, or kamikaze missions against targets in Urals and Siberia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83492)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia's expanded UAV launch infrastructure with 59 identified rails along Ukrainian and Belarusian borders enables sustained mass drone waves overwhelming Ukrainian air defenses. The degradation of Patriot systems due to interceptor shortages creates critical gaps in ballistic missile defense. Russian A-50U deployment has effectively neutralized Ukrainian Flamingo cruise missile strikes. Simultaneous UAV attacks on Sumy civilians, Odesa port infrastructure, and Moscow approaches demonstrate Russia's capacity for multi-axis pressure. The Novosoloshino liberation indicates continued Russian offensive operations in Zaporizhzhia despite Ukrainian defenses.
sections.regional_response: EU preparing largest sanctions package since 2022 targeting ~33% more Russian entities and individuals per Kallas. Latvia requesting €7 billion from EU budget to cover sanctions consequences and defense costs. Romania intercepted UAV violating airspace with Spanish F-18 under NATO policing. Binance transferred user data on Ukraine donors to Russian authorities per reports. Poland reported attack on Ukrainian-speaking teenagers. Western analysts assess Putin's 2027 Donbas deadline as strategic benchmark for potential negotiations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian mobilization enforcement intensifying with 1.5 million police referrals and reports of commissars revoking cultural worker deferments. FSB blackmail operations targeting Ukrainian volunteers with family in Russia reveal sophisticated coercion tactics. Russian oil export disruptions via Black Sea drone attacks on tankers and Novorossiysk terminal indicate Ukrainian asymmetric targeting of economic infrastructure. Ukrainian "Dovbush" UAV development signals strategic shift toward deep-strike capability against Russian rear areas. French mercenary casualty claims suggest significant foreign fighter attrition.
